messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: Elevated tail latency for tenant alcyon-thera (dedicated pool dp-us-west-2-03). Current p95 request latency -> 4.2s, error spike 0.8% in the last 5m. Paging on-call.

Alex M.: saw the page, looking. Is this impact only to alcyon?

Priya R.: yes, metrics show 100% of errors originating from their scheduler queue. Other tenants on the pool normal.

Marcos L.: on it. Initial hypothesis: scheduler is creating very large batches for long sequences causing eviction thrash and head-of-line delay. 

Jen (Support): customer reported timeouts in their UI around 10:36 UTC, escalating to legal/compliance teams. They're asking for immediate mitigation and an incident timeline.

Sam O.: quick mitigation plan: 1) cap max_batch_tokens for alcyon tenant to 1024, 2) enable per-tenant queue shaper with qps=8 while we investigate, 3) fallback to smaller model variant if latency still high. Anyone object?

Alex M.: +1 do it. Marcos, can you apply the knob?

Marcos L.: applying now. Patch below (tenant routing config):

```yaml
tenant_overrides:
  alcyon-thera:
    max_batch_tokens: 1024
    queue_shaper:
      mode: burst_smoothing
      target_qps: 8
```

Marcos L.: pushed config to staging, doing canary on 2 hosts in dp-us-west-2-03, then roll to remaining hosts.

incident-bot: Config change deployed to canary hosts at 1976543285. Auto-monitoring will report back in 60s.

Priya R.: watching traces. p95 dropped from 4.2s -> 2.1s on canary. Errors down to 0.2%. Good sign.

Jen (Support): telling customer we're doing an engineer push and temporary rate shaping. ETA 10-15m for verification.

Sam O.: after canary looks good, plan to incrementally apply to rest of pool in 60s windows. We'll keep canaries for 10m.

Alex M.: also prepare a graceful fallback to the 7B quantized model if we see degradation after full rollout. Marcos, can you stage the fallback policy?

Marcos L.: staged policy with automatic fallback threshold: p95 > 3.0s for 2 consecutive minutes -> route to alcyon-thera-7b-quant. Rule added to routing config.

incident-bot: Canary metrics at 1976543350: p95=1.9s, errors=0.15%. No anomalies.

Priya R.: starting rollout to remaining hosts at 1976543370. Rolling window 45s per host.

Sam O.: monitoring logs for queue depth and kv cache evictions. Runbook step 3: if we see >15% kv evictions, revert to pre-change and open a ticket to engineering for scheduler tuning.

Marcos L.: halfway through rollout. queue depth dropping, batch sizes now average 10 requests / ~800 token batches, previously 24 / ~2200 tokens. Token-batching is the issue.

Alex M.: good. make a note to revisit tenant's workload profile, ask them for typical sequence length distribution. They may need recommendation to chunk or limit max input tokens.

Jen (Support): alcyon asked if this will cost them more. I told them temporary shaper may increase p99 slightly but prevents timeouts. They're OK for now but want postmortem.

incident-bot: Rollout completed at 1976543490. Post-change metrics: p95=1.8s, p99=3.6s, errors=0.12%.

Priya R.: observed 3 small spikes when a single large job hit multiple requests; fallback policy didn't trigger. Looks stable.

Sam O.: preparing handoff notes for next on-call (Elaine). Elaine, baseline to watch: alcyon p95 < 2.5s, p99 < 4.5s, error_rate < 0.5%. If exceeded, first action: scale dedicated pool by +1 host or flip fallback to 7B.

Elaine S.: ack, I'll take it. Please paste the exact command to reapply the cap if needed.

Marcos L.: command to reapply via infra-api: 

```
infractl tenant update --id alcyon-thera --set max_batch_tokens=1024 --set queue_shaper.target_qps=8
```
Marcos L.: also leaving the canary hosts pinned for 10m to ensure no regressions.

Alex M.: after-action items: 1) create eval to reproduce token distribution, 2) add a tenant-level autoscaler doc (how to size pool), 3) follow up with model team on kernel selection for heavy long-sequence loads.

Jen (Support): I'll create incident ticket INC-ALC-197654 and notify account execs with mitigation summary and next steps.

Elaine S.: thanks team, taking over monitoring. Adding a note: next 2 hours watch for billing/tokens anomalies for alcyon.

Alex M.: great job everyone. closing the active page unless anyone sees further issues. :thumbsup:

Sam O.: leaving channel, on-call handoff in 45m.

incident-bot: Incident status changed to mitigated at 1976543790.
